en: Cittasaṁsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhūduka (The Dyad on Mental Conjoined, Produced, and Coexistent)

Dependent on a state that is not conjoined with mind, not produced by mind, and not co-existent, there arises a state that is not conjoined with mind, not produced by mind, and not co-existent, by way of root condition … (Abbreviated.
Nine under root; … pe … nine under non-disappearance.
